data.text:
ANTHROPIC JUST SHIPPED A “CHEAPER OPUS” THAT MAY COST MORE TO USE

Claude Sonnet 5 is live in https://t.co/a6Djrx5C0b and Claude Code.

Anthropic is positioning it as near-Opus 4.8 performance at a lower price, but the early read is messier than that.

the good:

> huge jump over Sonnet 4.6
> strong at design and UI
> very good one-shot app generation
> available now in Claude and Claude Code
> supports vision, unlike GLM 5.2

the weird part:

Sonnet 5 looks close to Opus 4.8 on some tasks, but it does not look token efficient.

intro pricing runs through August 31:

> $2 / 1M input tokens
> $10 / 1M output tokens

then it moves to:

> $3 / 1M input tokens
> $15 / 1M output tokens

the reviewer’s take:

Opus 4.8 on high can still be the better deal than Sonnet 5 on max for similar agentic performance.

so “cheaper model” does not automatically mean cheaper workflow.

the most interesting part is what Anthropic didn’t train it for:

cybersecurity.

Sonnet 5 is much weaker than Opus 4.8 and Mythos on exploit-style tasks, which looks deliberate after the Fable/Mythos government mess.

that may be how Anthropic gets strong models out without triggering the same regulatory wall.

real tests looked strong:

> clean web design without obvious AI slop
> single-file real-time 3D location tracker
> voxel pagoda scene with day/night controls
> solid UI components and visual composition

the takeaway:

Sonnet 5 is not an Opus replacement.

it’s a safer, design-heavy, agent-friendly workhorse that may be great in Claude Code, but not always the cheapest path.

bookmark this before you switch your whole stack to Sonnet 5

⚔️ Closed-source frontier vs open-source local — I put them head to head

♠ Claude Sonnet 5 🆚 Ornith 1.0 35B, running on my own GPU

🔹Sonnet 5 — Anthropic's most agentic Sonnet yet, near Opus 4.8 at a fraction of the cost
🔹Ornith 35B — open-source MoE coding model, MIT licensed, runs fully local
🔹Same tests, same prompts: autonomous bug-fixing 🐛 + one-shot code generation 🚂
🔹Can a model on your own hardware keep up with a frontier closed model? 👀

🔥 full video below 👇

https://t.co/sR19tN6kKu

→ Claude Blog
30 sub-skills, 5 agents, and a 5-gate delivery contract. Every draft passes Capability, Format, Visual, Content Review, and Asset Integrity, or it iterates up to 3 times. Ships to Next.js, Astro, WordPress, Ghost.
https://t.co/VEudH9EDAj

→ claude-skills
337 skills covering 30+ agents and 70+ commands. C-level personas for CFO, CMO, CRO, CPO, COO, CHRO, CISO. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and 9 more agents.
https://t.co/p2JJvdjigL

→ ai-marketing-claude
15 marketing skills with 5 parallel subagents. Type /market audit + any URL and get a full scored breakdown across content, CRO, SEO, positioning, brand, and growth in one shot.
https://t.co/pRpHEJBjoz

→ social-media-skills
The actual stack behind Charlie Hills' content system. 350K+ followers across LinkedIn, Instagram, Substack, X, and YouTube. Voice builder, post scorer, carousel generator, reels scripting.
https://t.co/j0g44hrDXT

→ marketingskills (Corey Haines)
The CRO and copywriting consultancy in skill form. Built by Corey Haines of Swipe Files and Conversion Factory. CRO, copy, SEO, analytics, email sequences, A/B test plans, ad creative.
https://t.co/xLVVujEGEW

→ OpenClaudia
67+ open-source marketing skills. SEO audits, blog writing, email sequences, competitor analysis, ad copy, Discord bots. Slash commands like /audit-seo, /write-blog, /email-sequence.
https://t.co/k1KiGVEmOM

→ Claude Code Video Toolkit
The Remotion docs baked into a skill. Generate React-based programmatic videos without hallucinating the API. Launch announcement videos, weekly metrics videos, shorts, all in code.
https://t.co/CHvPP64l0k

→ head-of-content
Viral content research via Apify + Gemini. Tracks X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube accounts you specify, identifies outlier posts, and reverse-engineers the patterns into briefs.
https://t.co/YntoFvWvZk

The agency stack used to live in a Notion board with 12 retainers.

Now it lives in `.claude/skills/`.

Bookmark this.

data.text:
Alright kids take out your chromebooks navigate to the orange app. This is claude, from here on out you will no longer need to think critically. We'll teach you how to write a Skill, prompt claude to create an mcp on times tables and then we're going to one shot a plinko app.

In all seriousness, primary school should be focused on teaching kids to begin problem solving. Introduce the dopamine loop of AI to that process too early and they'll be cooked for life. Lets not repeat social media.
